todo_reason: Maintainer tool, hidden under the 2026-10-10 owner ruling (user-facing tools only): calibration_survey.py runs calibrate_thresholds over every registry signal and writes one comparison table plus a JSON survey ledger for the maintainer to review against the selection criteria in scripts/calibration/PROVENANCE.md.
